decisions.reason: False positive: step 1.1 of lem-the-casimir-operator-is-basis-independent-and-intertwining explicitly identifies sum_i x_i tensor x^i with the inverse form tensor via g tensor g* = End(g), before multiplication into U(g). Thus F4 cites a proved intermediate conclusion, not an inference from the Casimir product alone. For fixed v a finite maximum of current cutoffs kills both normal-ordered tails; the fixed-r bilinear operator contraction is basis independent. No additional prerequisite or item edit is needed.

Confirmed logic defect: centrality implies that rho(C) commutes with every rho(L_m), but does not imply rho(C)=c I_V on an arbitrary module. For example, left multiplication on U(Vir) is a Lie representation and sends 1 to C, which is not a scalar multiple of 1 by PBW. Qualified central charge by the explicit condition C acts as c id_V, retaining the Lie bracket and all module classes. No AC or extra prerequisite is needed.

The complete supplier proof uses stabilized finite cutoffs, invariant tensor cancellation, and the signed boundary sum sum f_n=n, so it covers negative n and n=0 as well. The positive-energy unitary subclass is restricted by definition. No item edit is warranted.
